Hsu Fang-Yi’s Vogue Taiwan Cover

Hsu Fang-Yi commands attention in a sleek black suit, her profile sharply defined against a warm orange backdrop. Her bold red lips and windswept hair add drama, while Cartier jewelry and a Balenciaga coat emphasize her refined strength. The studio lighting accentuates every contour, capturing the dancer’s poised elegance and dynamic presence.

source.description:
Sheu Fang Yi’s Powerful Portrait

In this Harper’s Bazaar Taiwan editorial, modern dance icon Sheu Fang Yi is captured in a bold, minimalist portrait. Clad in a black high‑neck top and skirt by Balenciaga, she intertwines her arms in front of her face, showcasing sculptural black nails and Cartier’s gold and diamond jewelry. The intense red backdrop amplifies the image’s dramatic tension and highlights her commanding presence.
